card.line: Gerar was an ancient city in the south of Canaan, near Gaza, where Abraham and Isaac stayed and where God protected and blessed them.

moments.title: Abraham and Sarah in Gerar
moments.text: While Abraham stayed in Gerar, he said Sarah was his sister, and King Abimelech had her brought to him. God came to Abimelech in a dream and told him to return her, because Abraham was a prophet.

moments.title: Isaac settles in Gerar
moments.text: During a famine, Isaac went to Abimelech at Gerar. The LORD told him not to go to Egypt and promised to be with him and bless him. So Isaac settled in Gerar.

moments.title: Quarrel over the wells
moments.text: The herdsmen of Gerar quarreled with Isaac's herdsmen over water, saying, "The water is ours!" Isaac moved on and dug another well, and at last there was no quarrel over it.

moments.title: A peace oath with Abimelech
moments.text: Abimelech came from Gerar to Isaac, and said they could see the LORD was with him. They asked for a covenant, and Isaac prepared a feast. The next morning they swore an oath to each other and left in peace.

moments.title: Asa chases the Cushites
moments.text: After the LORD struck down the Cushites, Asa and his army pursued them as far as Gerar. Judah attacked the cities around Gerar and carried off much plunder.
